deploy-bot: [INFO] Deploy request queued -> env: prod | tag: v2.3.7 | commit: 7f4d2a3 | requested-by: @alex. Reason: concurrent-deploys-limit. Queue position: 3/4. Estimated retry/backoff schedule: 60s, 120s, 240s.
alex: ack. this is the payment hotfix that dedups charges. need it live ASAP but won't spam.
maria: we should consider priority bump. customers are reporting duplicates.
sre-omar: currently 2 running deploys (canary-418, batch-jobs). concurrent limit = 2. queueing is expected. monitoring shows normal resource headroom but release gating holds.
deploy-bot: auto-retry enabled. manual override possible by a user with release_privs (/deploy-priority high) — will preempt queue. @sam_pm FYI for change-window.
jack: @sam_pm are we inside a change window or close to one ending?
sam_pm: change window ends in ~20m. prefer to push now if it can go cleanly. if we escalate, please ping support for a note.
jenna: reminder: preempted deploys can still fail health-check; fallback policy will abort and roll back if startup health < 99% after 5 mins.
maria: if someone with perms does /deploy-priority high, it'll create a reserved slot and jump ahead. who has perms online?
alex: I'll try escalate. running: `# deployctl escalate dpl-queue --job-tag v2.3.7 --reason hotfix`
deploy-bot: Received manual priority bump from @alex. New queue position: 1/2 (preempt reserved). Next attempt scheduled in ~90s once current slot drains.
infra-bot: note: this release includes a small DB migration guard; initial startup will run a db-check which may add ~20s to warmup.
sre-omar: I'll watch canary startup. if >1% 5xx during warmup I'll abort.
deploy-bot: [START] Deploy dpl-20260309-119 -> env: prod | tag: v2.3.7 | commit: 7f4d2a3 | node-pool: pool-3. Started by: @alex.
deploy-bot: streaming logs: "migrations: guard check OK" "service-up: 3 instances healthy"
deploy-bot: [FINISH] Deploy dpl-20260309-119 completed successfully. Duration: 165s. Post-deploy checks: passed.
sam_pm: thanks team. I'll add short release note to #announcements and notify support.
maria: monitoring looks green on payments cluster :tada:
sre-omar: leaving an eye for next 30m but no immediate action. we'll open a follow-up if anything regresses.
alex: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
jenna: noted for release notes: include rollback steps and DB guard detail in case we need to revert.
